question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"perspective."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Perspective"** means a particular point of view or way of looking at something. (समस्‍या को जानने और निर्णय लेने का सही दृष्टिकोण; परिप्रेक्ष्‍य) • **Example**:* Hearing about others’ experiences often helps to put your own problems into **perspective__.*** • In this context, the blank requires a word that can be used to describe a way of thinking or looking at something. • The correct answer is Option 1. • Correct passage: Humans have __assumed__ that animals do not have a life and maybe exploited in any way they see fit, but this __**perspective**__ is incorrect and must be altered before it is too late. We fail to recognise that the pain we ______ (3) ______ on animals will come back to haunt us, and no matter how ______ (4) ______ the discovery we make by causing harm to animals, it will be futile. It can never ______ (5) ______ the human actions. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Fact"** refers to something that is known to be true based on evidence or experience. (तथ्‍य, सचाई) • **"Data"** refers to information, especially numerical information, that can be analyzed and used to make decisions. ((तकनीकी अंग्रेज़ी में बहुवचन संज्ञा के रूप में प्रयुक्त जबकि एकवचन रूप datum है) तथ्‍य समूह या सूचना-संग्रह, डाटा) • **"Superstition"** refers to beliefs or practices that are not based on evidence or reason and are often based on tradition or cultural beliefs. (अंधविश्‍वास) 3f:Teba, The correct answer is **"inflict."**
